newsitem.title: SWEDEN: Swedish shares fall weighed down by Astra, forests.
newsitem.headline: Swedish shares fall weighed down by Astra, forests.

text.p: Profit taking, a weaker U.S. stock market, and a large fall in drugs company Astra depressed Swedish share prices on Wednesday.
The Stockholm Stock Exchange's general index fell 0.7 percent to 2304.98 in turnover of 4.17 billion crowns.
"The bourse seems to be slavishly following developments in the U.S. and strong profit-taking triggered by yesterday's strong lift on the exchange," one broker said.
Astra plunged 7.0 crowns to 327.5 crowns on profit taking after going strong for a couple of days. It dragged the drugs sector down 1.48 percent.
The forestry sector dropped 1.01 percent on profit taking after being a favourite sector since Thursday last week. MoDo fell one to 192.5 crowns and Stora slipped one to 95 crowns.
Household appliance group Electrolux dropped 8.50 crowns to 411.50 after a company spokesman did not agree with the upbeat hopes for a strong upturn in economic trends.

Shipping shares attracted a lot of attention and rose with dealers saying that investors were turning to sectors that have lagged. Analysts pointed to an expected increase in oil consumption next year and low inventory levels world-wide.
